lines.en: : So yeah, that basically sums up how I feel about phlebotomy.
: That's nice and all, but I really don't remember asking you anything even remotely close to that.
: You didn't? Because I could have sworn I heard you specifically ask for my thoughts on phlebotomy.
: Again, no. I asked you why you've been following me around for the past fifteen minutes when you're supposed to be in gym class right now.
: Because spending time with you is much better for my health than running around the track a few times.
: Smooth.
: And true. Gym class doesn't really do anything for me since I'm already the picture of perfect health.
: Plus, doesn't walking down the hall with someone so clearly in love with you make you feel all masculine and important and stuff?
: Not really. It just feels like any other day to me so far.
: Sure! Except you're going to spend the rest of the day with me and you never really do that, so it can't be that normal. Right, Sensei?
: Ayane, go away or you're going to get me in trouble.
: For real? I thought this was the part where you take me to your super-secret sex dungeon and show me all of your cool...sex tools.
: If I had a super-secret sex dungeon, I can assure you it wouldn’t be on[school] grounds.
: Sure, Sensei. That’s just what you want me to think.
: Ayane, seriously. I am exercising my teacher powers to demand you go to the gym right now. I have to walk around the halls and look important and you are getting in the way of that.
: How come I have to go but not you?! You know that your duties as a teacher include physical education as well, right?!
: Wait, they do? Since when?
: Since always. It wasn't until recently that you started skipping that period, so I figured I'd follow you around today and try to figure out why.
: That's nice and all, but how does going on a rant about phlebotomy and asking me to take you to a sex dungeon have anything to do with that?
: The phlebotomy thing was just a tangent, but if you really do have a sex dungeon, I will understand why you haven't been showing up to gym lately.
: There is no sex dungeon, Ayane.
: Okay, but there should be. I can't really think of any place better for one of those.
: I have a guy who's really good at installing those fake bookcase door thingies if you need help preparing one.
: I actually already have my own secret room at school that I haven't told you about. You can put yours right next to mine and we can talk to each other through the wall.
: Why would you possibly need a secret room in school?
: I don't know. For secret stuff?
: You'll never know when you need a secret room, Sensei. I learned that in the war.
: Anyway, wanna head to the gym and stare at my legs while I walk around in bloomers?
: It's a nice alternative to the sex dungeon. Also, I think if you miss another gym period Makoto will actually kill you.
: You know, I'm honestly surprised I missed any at all since bloomers are involved.
: I hereby promise to never miss another gym period again. And it's all thanks to you, Ayane.
: Your words are no good here, Sensei. You can thank me by staring at me longer than the other girls and occasionally winking at me to remind me that I'm your #1.
: I...will do my best, Ayane.
Meanwhile...
: The fuck is even the point of havin' a teacher if he is goin' to be the one who fucking skips class?
: Why'd I even leave the dorm in the first place? Could've just stayed at fuckin' home and it would've made literally zero difference.
: Yumi, chill. You don't have to always talk like such a thug, you know?
: Besides, the things you're saying right now make it sound like you want Sensei here. Doesn't that go against your whole...thing?
: What thing? And I ain't talkin' like a thug! This is just how I fuckin' talk!
: Yeah, well, the way you normally talk sounds the same as how a thug normally talks. Do with that what you will.
: Oh, give me a break. The fuck do you know about how people on the streets talk?
: However much I've learned from you over the last couple years, I guess.
: And why the fuck are you just sitting there? I don't remember inviting you to hang out with us.
: Yumi, Futaba was there before we even sat down.
: Well she should have left as soon as we sat down.
: I don't...really have anything to-
: Speak the fuck up. I can't hear you.
: Umm...I said I...don’t really have anything to say.
: Figures. You never have anything to say, do you.
: All you do is just fuckin' sit there taking up half the gym and making that one girl who's always hanging around you look like fifty times better than she actually is.
: That girl has a name, Yumi. It's Rin.
: And the fact that you even need to be reminded of that when you have known her since middle school is pretty unbelievable.
: You sayin' that I'm just pretending to not remember her name? The fuck is your problem today?
: My problem? I've been sitting here for the last ten minutes looking up sales on Amazon while all you've done is bitch and moan about literally everything.
: Yeah, well...it's a free country, ain't it? I can bitch and moan about whatever I want, whenever I want and you can't do shit.
: Ugh...Why do I even bother?
: Hey. You must know where our fucking asshole teacher is, right?
: Figure since you're always starin' at him and shit that you probably just know where he is at all times.
: The fuck is up with that anyway? You trying to suck his dick or something?
: Wh...What?!
: Yumi, are you fucking kidding me right now? Listen to yourself. Futaba did literally nothing to you.
: Of course she did literally nothing to me. Fatass probably hasn't done a single fucking thing in her life.
: Hey, why don't you get up and go look for him or something? You could use the exercise, right?
: Yumi, knock it the fuck off right now! I'm serious!
: Oh yeah? How serious, Chika? You gonna fight me if I keep goin' or something?
: You'd love that wouldn't you? But no, I'm not going to fight you just because you woke up and decided to be a fucking bitch today.
: Seriously, though. Why did you even come here if this is all you planned on doing?
: Hey, I didn't plan this. If anything, it's our fucking teacher's fault this is happening since none of this shit would be going on if he just did his job for once.
: That is fucking bullshit and you know it.
: Hey, Futaba. I'm really sorry for being in such a bad mood today.
: I just...
: Well, I really really care about all of the starving children out there. And knowing you could singlehandedly end world hunger by just giving up your lunch for the day kinda triggers me.
: Okay, that’s it!
: Futaba, come with me. We'll find Sensei together and let him deal with Yumi's BS so you don't have to.
: I don't understand...
: Hahaha...hahahahaha!
: Oh, come on! It was just a joke! We all know it's in good fun, right?!
: Fuck off, Yumi! You can sleep in the dorm yourself tonight. I'll go stay with Chinami myself.
: Hey, sorry I’m late. I got a little caught up in-
: That doesn't matter right now. Can you take Futaba to the nurse's office for a little while?
: Oh. Sure. Is something wrong?
: Yeah, Yumi. For whatever reason, she just decided to torment the poor girl again today.
: I'm fine...I really don't-
: I know you're fine. You deal with this way too much and I'm really sorry that Yumi's constantly saying things like that to you. It's really not fair.
: I just don't want her to keep going...and getting Yumi out of the gym would take an entire militia at this rate.
: So just...cool off and relax with Sensei for a little while. He'll know how to handle this.
That is giving me far too much credit for something I am absolutely not prepared to deal with.
: I'm sorry, Sensei...I didn't mean to inconvenience you...
: It's not an inconvenience at all.
: Let's just...head over to the nurse's office and hang out there until gym is over...
: I'm sorry again, Futaba...I'll talk to Yumi for the millionth time later tonight.
: It's fine...really. And thank you for standing up to her...
: It means a lot, Chika...It really does...
: Of course. I've got you, girl.
: And, between you and me, the only reason that I didn't fight her back there is because I wouldn't be able to afford her hospital bills.
: She might talk big, but that girl ain't got shit on me.
: Hahah...hah......hah...
Futaba and I take a walk over to the nurse's office, but she's so embarrassed by whatever happened while I was away that she doesn't say anything the entire time.
Eventually, the bell rings and she waves me off so she can walk back to the locker room and get changed.
And despite how I know I should be walking back with her to make sure she's okay, I understand that being alone might just be...better for her in her current condition.
I'll definitely have to talk to Yumi about this, though.
I still have no idea how to deal with her, but...
I can't just let this go on if it's going to be affecting some of the other girls this badly.
Futaba's affection has increased to [futaba_love]!
